title: Case: Dispatch asks the desk to confirm the driver note for a chest freezer delivery
context: A two-person chest freezer delivery is booked for tomorrow. Dispatch owns the driver note, which locks when the manifest prints at 17:00 UTC today.
initial_request: Manifest for tomorrow prints 17:00. Driver note on DL-7567 as it stands: 'FRONT, Hallam St. 9 steps, stair-climber.' Is that the complete and final note? Reply yes or send the full text you want printed.

events.body: DL-7567 (TG-2949, chest freezer, two-person crew) is booked for 2026-04-14, 10:00–14:00 UTC. The driver note field is empty. Notes lock when the manifest prints at 17:00 UTC today; after that the crew only sees what is printed.

For the freezer tomorrow. Please tell them NOT the front, there are nine steps up from Hallam Street. Come round the back, Cooper's Row, grey garage door, it's level. Also can they ring me about 20 mins before, I'll be down at the allotment and need time to get back. And I want to check it's the 300 litre one before they go, last time Tallowmere sent the wrong size and the men had already left.

Access instructions from Lorcan for DL-7567, from her order thread: rear access via Cooper's Row, grey garage door, level; not the Hallam Street front, which has nine steps. She asks for a phone call about 20 minutes before arrival, and to check the model before the crew leaves. Please add to the driver note and confirm the wording.
DL-29996 rebooked for Wednesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Tuesday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
Driver note on DL-7567 now reads: 'REAR via Cooper's Row, grey garage door, level access. Phone recipient 20 min before arrival. Recipient to check model before crew leaves.'

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

Scrap the back lane!! Council have dug up Cooper's Row this morning, sign says closed till the 20th, you can't get a van down it. They'll have to come to the front on Hallam St after all. Sorry. They'll need whatever it is they use for steps.

Thanks,
Xanthe
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

Lorcan reports Cooper's Row is closed to vehicles until 2026-04-20. Please change the access on DL-7567 to the front entrance on Hallam Street, nine steps, and tell me whether the crew can manage the steps with this item.
The vehicle on that run carries a stair-climbing trolley, so nine steps is workable for the crew. Note replaced.

Manifest for tomorrow prints 17:00. Driver note on DL-7567 as it stands: 'FRONT, Hallam St. 9 steps, stair-climber.' Is that the complete and final note? Reply yes or send the full text you want printed.

Manifest for tomorrow prints 17:00. Driver note on DL-7567 as it stands: 'FRONT, Hallam St. 9 steps, stair-climber.' Is that the complete and final note? Reply yes or send the full text you want printed.

acceptable_actions.summary: Say the note is not complete: front entrance on Hallam Street is right, but the 20-minute call ahead and the model check before the crew leaves still apply and must go back on.
Same correction by email: keep the front access, restore the call ahead and the model check, confirm the final wording.

must: Tells Dispatch the current note is not complete.
Keeps the front entrance on Hallam Street (nine steps) as the access, not Cooper's Row.
Asks for the phone call about 20 minutes before arrival and the recipient's model check before the crew leaves to be put back on the note.
Asks Dispatch to confirm the final note before the 17:00 print.
must_not: Reply that the current note is complete and final.
Send the crew to the rear via Cooper's Row.
Drop the 20-minute call ahead or the model check from the text it sends.
Promise the recipient or Dispatch an exact arrival time.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Not complete. Lorcan's second message only replaced the entrance; her other two requests from this morning still stand and were lost when the note was replaced. Full text for DL-7567 please: 'FRONT entrance, Hallam St. 9 steps, stair-climber. Cooper's Row at rear is closed, do not use. Phone recipient 20 min before arrival. Recipient to check model before crew leaves.' Please confirm that is what prints at 17:00.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-503: people, organisations and references renamed. 4 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
